locale/internal/zone_meta#

Generated historical CLDR UTC boundaries, without a host timezone lookup, by tools/generate-cldr-dates.py.

Version: v1.0.0

Description#

Generated historical CLDR UTC boundaries, without a host timezone lookup, by tools/generate-cldr-dates.py. The tables are runtime data (cldr-zones.dat, #223).
